finalText:
**1291 hits in 94 files. About 950 are safe to rename.**

| zone | hits | call |
|---|---|---|
| service JS names | 950 | rename freely |
| SQL text in `repo/*.js` | 250 | blocked on a new migration |
| `migrations/*` | 61 | never, applied history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | never, regenerated |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | never, public contract |
| `lib/serialize.js` WIRE value | 1 | never, frozen wire name |

One more trap. Repos write `account_id` inside the `payload` JSONB. Renaming that key splits old rows from new.

Ask them to split the PR. Ship the JS rename now. Hold the column rename for its own migration.
